demoDataNote: All figures are fictional demonstration data.

totalEmployees.label: Total employees
totalEmployees.tooltip: All employees on record, including inactive employees (for example on unpaid leave). Compared with the end of last month.

activeEmployees.label: Active employees
activeEmployees.tooltip: Employees currently working (total employees minus inactive). Compared with the end of last month.

newHires.label: New hires this month
newHires.tooltip: Employees who joined since the start of this month. Compared with the whole of last month.

onLeaveToday.label: On leave today
onLeaveToday.tooltip: Active employees on approved leave today. Compared with yesterday.

attendanceRate.label: Attendance today
attendanceRate.tooltip: Employees present today, including late arrivals, as a share of employees expected at work (active employees not on leave). Compared with yesterday.

openPositions.label: Open positions
openPositions.tooltip: Vacancies currently open for hiring. Compared with the end of last month.

employeeGrowth.subtitle: Headcount at the end of each month, last 12 months
